what: The heading is split into letters inside word chunks. When its top edge reaches 85% of the screen, each letter resolves in random order from blur 8px and transparent in .4s power2.out (total stagger spread .2s), so letters switch on as if coming into focus here and there. With on: load it plays right on attach in 1.2s with a .8s spread (big hero heading), and with on: state it plays when is-in is added to the element. Once resolved, it never hides again.

options.dur: Time for one character to settle in (sec), default .4 · load 1.2
options.spread: Total spread of random order (sec), default .2 · load .8
options.ease: Curve("0.25,1,0.5,1" such as four Bezier values or a GSAP name), default power2.out
